title: Accurate Designs
description: Every icon is based on the application's official monochrome design, or the brand's primary logo when a monochrome version is unavailable.

title: Broad Compatibility
description: Works seamlessly across modern Android launchers that support third-party icon packs.

title: Community Driven
description: Actively maintained by the community. Request missing icons through the app or contribute your own designs directly on GitHub.

title: Based on Lawnicons
description: Built on the foundation of Lawnicons. Core changes from every new Lawnicons release are continuously merged into Monocons.
